_README: Register passes whose cited metas cannot give their whole cost, keyed by pass_id. basis 'published': a cleanup leg overwrote the pass's meta, and the figure is the one its post-run report published, cited in source (PI ruling D13). basis 'audited-lower-bound': the meta was overwritten the same way and no report publishes the leg, so the register prices the tokens that remain (the cleanup's) and labels the figure a LOWER bound rather than calling it audited. Read by scripts/lib_pass_cost.py. Seeded 2026-10-03 from results/tile-presence-2026-09-21/verifier-costs.json, which identified the overwritten stages; a figure found later for a lower-bound leg (for example a June per-run audit) replaces its entry as 'published' with its source.
